query.statement: INSERT INTO TB_TRAININGCOURSE (TRAININGCOURSE_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, SYSDATE, ?, SYSDATE)
SELECT TRAININGCOURSE_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_TRAININGCOURSE WHERE NAME LIKE '%' || ? || '%' AND STATUS_CD = ? ORDER BY UPDATED_AT DESC
SELECT TRAININGCOURSE_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_TRAININGCOURSE WHERE TRAININGCOURSE_ID = ?
UPDATE TB_TRAININGCOURSE SET NAME = ?, STATUS_CD = ?, UPDATED_BY = ?, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE TRAININGCOURSE_ID = ?
